content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, digital creators face a critical infrastructure gap: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|USDT Payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves creators unable to sell their digital products—[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-everything-you-need-get-8|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]], courses, templates—to a global audience. The solution is not a workaround but a sovereign commerce stack. This guide walks you through deploying Supabase as your order database, integrated with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-6|cloudflare]] Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments. By the end, you’ll own a fully operational digital store that accepts crypto payments, delivers products instantly, and gives you full data control—no platform dependencies.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is designed for creators who cannot rely on traditional payment gateways. Supabase, a serverless PostgreSQL database, acts as your order storage, while Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, and NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The architecture is decentralized: no single point of failure, no subscriptions, and no platform lock-in. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. This is not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent infrastructure shift built to withstand financial isolation and currency collapse.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting, ensure you have a Cloudflare account, a Supabase project, and a NOWPayments API key. Familiarize yourself with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. If you’re deploying Stack 01, you’ll need Google Apps Script for backend logic. For Stack 02, Cloudflare Workers and Supabase are your backend tools. Prepare your digital products—upload them to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Finally, test your payment pipeline on a testnet before going live. This preparation ensures a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. Set up webhooks to trigger product delivery once payment is confirmed on-chain. Use Supabase to store order details—customer email, product ID, transaction hash. For delivery, link your product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate secure, time-limited download URLs. Test the pipeline with a small transaction on a testnet. Ensure the webhook fires correctly, the order is logged in Supabase, and the product is delivered instantly. This layer is critical—it’s where payment meets fulfillment.
Own your infrastructure—no platform dependencies, no subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Point your custom domain if you have one. Switch your NOWPayments integration to mainnet and monitor the webhook logs. When a customer purchases, the payment is verified on-chain, the order is logged in Supabase, and the product is delivered via a secure URL. Your first live transaction is a proof point—your infrastructure is now operational. Promote your store with confidence, knowing the backend is handling payments and delivery automatically.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, focus on scaling. Add more products to your Supabase database and update your storefront. Optimize for low-fee crypto networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. Monitor transaction volumes and adjust your Supabase tier if needed. For advanced scaling, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)—COREMERCH deploys Stack 02 in 48 hours, end-to-end tested, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured for email deliverability. This stack is built for growth, giving you the infrastructure to expand without platform restrictions.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for payment processing. For backend logic, use Google Apps Script (Stack 01) or Cloudflare Workers (Stack 02). Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. This combination gives you a fully operational store with no hosting fees, a 0.5% payment processing fee, and full ownership of your infrastructure.
Crypto payments bypass financial restrictions, giving you global reach.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to deploy this stack quickly, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH includes Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested, with 5 products loaded and email deliverability configured. For a DIY approach, start with the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for full documentation and source code. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options and choose the stack that fits your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a Cloudflare account and Supabase project. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and generate an API key. 3. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 4. Configure NOWPayments webhooks to trigger product delivery. 5. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 6. Test the payment pipeline on a testnet before going live. 7. Monitor webhook logs and order storage in Supabase. 8. Promote your store and process your first live transaction.
Frequently Asked Questions
What’s the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, deployed in 4-6 hours. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing.
Can I use this stack if I’m in a country with strict financial regulations?
Yes, this stack is designed for regions where Stripe and PayPal are restricted. It relies on crypto payments, which bypass traditional financial systems.
How do I ensure my product delivery is secure?
Use time-limited, secure URLs generated by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Store product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 with restricted access.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Accept payments on BSC, Solana, or TRON networks—transaction fees are under $0.10, making them ideal for digital products.
Do I need technical expertise to deploy this stack?
Basic familiarity with GitHub, Cloudflare, and crypto payments is required. For a fully managed deployment, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH.
Supabase and Cloudflare Workers scale with your business, no matter the size.
